short_description: Production server disk full causing application crash
description: Application server prod-app-02 ran out of disk space. Application logs stopped being written and the application crashed due to inability to write temp files.
symptoms: disk full, application crash, log write failures
root_cause_notes: Log rotation was disabled after a configuration change 2 weeks ago. Logs accumulated and filled the disk.
resolution_notes: Cleared old logs manually. Re-enabled log rotation. Added disk space monitoring alert.
work_notes: SSH'd into server at 03:15. Confirmed disk at 100%. Found log rotation disabled in config. Cleared 45GB of old logs.
close_notes: Log rotation re-enabled. Disk monitoring alert set at 80% threshold.
